Just steps away from the historic Hanoi Old Quarter, this 4+ star boutique hotel is an ideal choice for upscale business travelers, those seeking a pampered vacation, or couples on a romantic getaway. With 60 elegantly appointed rooms, the hotel is spacious enough to provide a full range of premium amenities including a panoramic sky bar, an award-winning restaurant, a coffee shop, a luxury spa, a tailoring boutique, a modern gym and an infinity pool—while still maintaining the intimate, personalized service you deserve. Step away from the bustling streets of Hanoi and into a serene retreat, where every detail is designed for your ultimate relaxation.
